jack-reson8-pro-motion-pro-motion-pro-mo.description: Pro Motion: make a high-taste motion-graphics launch film, brand film, TVC or promo video and the unconventional campaign around it, audio first: pick a surprising campaign mechanism (media hijack, fake-broken ads, meme replies, UGC army, FOOH), plan the music as a marketing asset, then render the film in code (canvas to MP4) cut to the beat with AE-style effects. Also builds stylized web pages the same way (official site, landing page, interactive hero: live WebGL type, cutout subjects, try-with-your-photo, waitlist). Use when the user asks for a launch video, product film, brand ad, app…
